name: Stride Pro Running Shoes
description: Lightweight mesh running shoes with a cushioned EVA midsole for all-day comfort. The breathable upper keeps feet cool on long runs.

name: Urban Leather Loafers
description: Handcrafted genuine leather loafers with a flexible rubber sole. A timeless pick for office wear and smart-casual evenings.

name: TrailGrip Hiking Boots
description: Waterproof ankle-high boots with an aggressive lug outsole for rugged terrain. Reinforced toe caps and padded collars protect against rocks and rubbing.

name: CloudStep Slide Sandals
description: Ultra-soft foam slides designed for post-workout recovery and beach days. Quick-drying and easy to clean with just water.

name: CourtMaster Canvas Sneakers
description: Classic low-top sneakers in durable canvas with a vulcanised rubber sole. Available in a clean white finish that pairs with almost anything.

name: Everyday Cotton Crew Tee
description: Soft 100% combed cotton t-shirt with a relaxed fit and reinforced stitching. A wardrobe staple that holds its shape wash after wash.

name: Indigo Slim-Fit Jeans
description: Stretch denim jeans with a modern slim cut and a deep indigo wash. Comfortable enough for daily wear and sharp enough for weekends out.

name: ThermoLayer Fleece Jacket
description: Midweight zip-up fleece that traps warmth without adding bulk. Perfect as a standalone layer or under a shell in colder weather.

name: Linen Blend Summer Shirt
description: Breathable linen-cotton shirt with a relaxed collar and button-down front. Keeps you cool and looking polished through the hottest months.

name: FlexFit Performance Joggers
description: Moisture-wicking joggers with a four-way stretch fabric and zippered pockets. Ideal for gym sessions, travel, and lounging alike.

name: PulseBuds Wireless Earbuds
description: True wireless earbuds with active noise cancellation and 24 hours of total battery life. Water-resistant design makes them suitable for workouts and commutes.

name: VoltMax 20000mAh Power Bank
description: High-capacity power bank with 22.5W fast charging and dual USB output. Charges a typical smartphone up to four times on a single charge.

name: SmartFit Band 5
description: Fitness tracker with heart rate, SpO2, and sleep monitoring on a bright AMOLED display. Battery lasts up to 14 days between charges.

name: SonicBoom Portable Speaker
description: Rugged Bluetooth speaker delivering punchy bass and clear vocals with IP67 protection. Enjoy up to 18 hours of playback on a single charge.

name: ProType Mechanical Keyboard
description: Compact 75% mechanical keyboard with hot-swappable switches and per-key RGB lighting. Supports wired and Bluetooth connections for flexible desk setups.

name: Summit 40L Trekking Backpack
description: Spacious 40-litre backpack with an adjustable ventilated back panel and integrated rain cover. Multiple compartments keep gear organised on multi-day treks.

name: NomadLite 2-Person Tent
description: Lightweight dome tent with a double-wall design and easy pole setup in under five minutes. Handles wind and light rain, making it ideal for weekend camping.

name: HydroKeep Insulated Bottle 1L
description: Double-wall stainless steel bottle that keeps drinks cold for 24 hours or hot for 12. The leak-proof lid and powder-coated finish stand up to daily adventures.

name: BeamX Rechargeable Headlamp
description: Compact headlamp with 600 lumens, multiple beam modes, and a USB-C rechargeable battery. Its adjustable tilt and splash-proof body make it great for night hikes.

name: CozyNight -5°C Sleeping Bag
description: Mummy-style sleeping bag with soft polyester lining and a thermal hood for cold nights. Packs down small into the included compression sack.
